header: Basket 13 Fable deep-dossiers — one entry per symbol, most recent re-underwrite wins. Written by _basket13_inject.py from each re-debate's Phase-0 dossiers[]; _basket13_export.py copies to frontend/public/basket13_dossiers.json for the /catalysts depth view.

FIP.thesis_summary: Signed definitive sale of Long Ridge Energy & Power to a MARA Holdings subsidiary for ~$1.52B (announced 4/30/26) closes in Q3 2026, eliminating $1.16B of Long Ridge debt at close plus ~$300M of net proceeds repaying parent debt; the deleveraged remain-co (Transtar rail, Jefferson Terminal, Repauno) re-rates toward ~$9 recovery value from $4.44. Verified live 2026-07-03: no FERC change-of-control order yet (June FERC meeting passed without it; management guides approval mid-Q3), PJM market monitor's 5/29 FERC filing is a conditioning request not a block, contractual outside date 2026-11-30 with a 7-month extension option. Balance-sheet track is active in parallel: 7/1/26 Jefferson took a $230M Jefferies bridge loan (matures 6/30/27) repaying the Series 2024B Beaumont bonds at maturity, and 6/29/26 FIP closed the $45M Tidewater bolt-on via term-loan upsize.
FIP.kill_risk: The FERC change-of-control order has NOT issued as of 2026-07-03 and the PJM independent market monitor's demanded condition (commit Long Ridge capacity/energy to PJM markets) strikes at MARA's core rationale of powering its own behind-the-meter data-center load — if FERC imposes it, MARA could contest, renegotiate, or run out the clock, pushing close from the Q3 guide toward the 11/30/26 outside date (extendable 7 months) or killing the deal. A delayed close compresses the remain-co refi runway now that Jefferson leans on a 1-year bridge maturing 6/30/27. Also note the $9 target embeds management run-rate segment EBITDA (~$250M+); on trailing run-rate the same math yields ~$5-6.

FIP.dossier_note: Catalyst re-verified live: PENDING_HARD stands. Definitive agreement (4/30/26) at fixed ~$1.52B; Q3 2026 guided close (FERC approval guided mid-Q3; outside date 11/30/26 + 7-mo extension), pending FERC/HSR/STB + MARA noteholder consent. FERC order NOT yet issued (June meeting passed without it) — 2026-09-30 milestone kept as guided-Q3 midpoint, not a contractual date. Floor arithmetic: $3.90 = confirmed 52-wk low (live quote). Target arithmetic: close wipes $1.16B LR debt + ~$300M parent repay; remain-co (Transtar/Jefferson/Repauno) at mgmt run-rate EBITDA ~$250M+ x ~10x infra EV less ~$1.2B residual net debt and ~$0.35B preferred = ~$0.95-1.1B equity / ~118M sh = ~$8-9.3 -> $9 defensible but ramp-dependent (trailing run-rate gives ~$5-6). New since board scan (neither fires the catalyst, both feed the Refi_restructuring driver): 7/1/26 $230M Jefferson bridge loan (Jefferies, SOFR-based, matures 6/30/27) repaid Series 2024B Beaumont bonds at maturity — clears 2026 maturity, creates a 2027 refi node; 6/29/26 closed $45M Tidewater Logistics bolt-on via term-loan upsize (adds modest leverage). SC 13D/A + Form 4s filed 7/2 (holder/insider activity, not deal-status). At live $4.44: R/R = (9-4.44)/(4.44-3.90) ~ 8.4:1.

VRDN.thesis_summary: Binary FDA-approval special situation on veligrotug (Lumvoa) for thyroid eye disease. The event RESOLVED WON: FDA approved Lumvoa on 2026-06-26, four days ahead of the 2026-06-30 PDUFA date, with immediate commercial launch (company 8-K accepted 2026-06-26, EDGAR CIK 0001590750; Business Wire 2026-06-26). Stock re-rated from the $16.31 setup to $19.40. The pre-event asymmetry ($8 rejection floor / $35 win target) no longer exists — remaining upside to $35 is ordinary launch-execution risk versus Amgen's incumbent Tepezza, not defined-risk event edge. Seat's edge is spent.
VRDN.kill_risk: Not applicable as an event kill — the catalyst fired favorably and irreversibly (clean approval, launch underway; post-approval EDGAR shows only routine Form 4s and an SC 13G). The honest residual risk applies only to any still-held seat: the gap from $19.40 to the old $35 win target is commercial-execution upside against entrenched Tepezza (payer access, launch ramp, competitive pricing), which is ordinary equity risk outside this sleeve's mandate.

VRDN.dossier_note: Re-underwritten 2026-07-03 from live sources: FMP quote ($19.40, mcap ~$1.75B), Business Wire press feed, EDGAR filings CIK 0001590750. VERDICT: catalyst FIRED WON. FDA approved Lumvoa (veligrotug-vvze) for TED on 2026-06-26 — ahead of the 2026-06-30 PDUFA — with immediate launch; company 8-K accepted 2026-06-26 18:18 ET confirms. Binary arithmetic at setup: win $35 / lose $8, entry $16.31 -> implied win prob ~31% (27p = 8.31). Realized: stock at $19.40, +19% from setup, well short of the $35 win leg — the residual is Tepezza-competition launch execution, not event asymmetry, so fair_value_target/downside_floor are nulled rather than defended as event axes. No forward dated milestone remains on this thesis; pipeline events (elegrobart REVEAL-2 positive 2026-05-05, ex-US filings, VRDN-003 subQ) are separate, undated catalysts that would need a fresh dossier, not a patch of this one. Balance-sheet note: May 2026 upsized $350M raise (1.75% converts due 2032 + common) pre-funded the launch. Data hygiene: FMP's VRDN feed mixes in Viridian Metals (CSE: VRDN, copper explorer) — those items were excluded. Recommendation to CRO/Director within my lane: this seat has no live event; any continuation is a new decision on a new thesis.

EYPT.thesis_summary: EyePoint's DURAVYU Phase 3 LUGANO wet-AMD topline is a genuine, unfired single-name binary. Trial is fully enrolled (enrollment completed Jul 2025), no topline exists as of Jul 3 2026, and three consecutive positive DSMC reviews (latest May 14 2026) reviewed masked SAFETY only — so the efficacy non-inferiority outcome vs aflibercept remains a true open binary. Downside is backstopped by a real balance sheet ($222.5M cash+STI at Q1'26, effectively no debt, no going-concern), though the specific $5.50 floor imputes pipeline residual above bare cash (~$2.65/sh). Spread has not closed (~$13.98 vs ~$37.50 win target).
EYPT.resolution_driver: Phase 3 clinical topline readout (DURAVYU LUGANO wet-AMD, primary BCVA endpoint) — company-run trial data, not an FDA action
EYPT.kill_risk: Timing softness on the load-bearing date: the company only guides "mid-2026" (a window, not a committed date); the 2026-07-31 "hard" date is a sell-side interpolation. Enrollment completed ~Jul 2025 and the primary endpoint is at 56 weeks, so last-patient-last-visit lands ~Aug-Sep 2026 — the readout can slip into Q3 (sell-side already models ~August). Second-order: the 60% win prob is NOT efficacy-de-risked — DSMC reviewed masked safety only, so Phase 3 non-inferiority on BCVA is genuinely unresolved; a miss would test the softness of the $5.50 floor (bare cash is only ~$2.65/sh vs a 52-wk low of $9.40).

EYPT.dossier_note: Catalyst REAL and UNFIRED: no LUGANO topline released as of 2026-07-03 (latest EYPT news is a Jun 16 inducement-grant boilerplate and a Jun 29 Motley Fool piece; no data). Trial fully enrolled Jul 2025; three positive DSMC reviews (Nov 2025, and May 14 2026 the third) all masked-SAFETY-only, so efficacy is an open binary. Company guides topline "mid-2026, LUCIA to follow shortly after"; sell-side ~August. FLOOR CHECK: Q1'26 (3/31) cash+STI=$222.5M, total debt only $20.2M capital leases, retained-earnings deficit but positive equity $230M, no going-concern — floor backstop is real; ~83.8M shares => cash/sh ~$2.65, so board's $5.50 floor = cash + ~$2.85/sh pipeline residual (DME COMO/CAPRI Phase 3 + Durasert platform + commercial YUTIQ), a soft/judgment floor (below the $9.40 52-wk low, reflecting a failure gap-down). VALUATION AXES REPRODUCE: EV = 0.6*37.5 + 0.4*5.5 = 22.5 + 2.2 = 24.7; vs live 13.98 => ev_pct = 24.7/13.98-1 = +76.7% (board 77.4% off its 13.9244 print). Payoff 37.5/13.98 = 2.68x. All within tolerance; kept fair_value 37.5 / floor 5.5 / win_prob 0.60. staging=false: trial is done enrolling and data is mechanically imminent (not a setup awaiting a trigger), even though the exact date is a window.

LZM.thesis_summary: Single-asset developer NAV re-rate on Kabanga Ni-sulfide (LZM 84%, Tanzania 16% free-carry) FID + financial close. Three live financing tracks: Taurus $60M senior secured bridge ($41.7M drawn 4/29/26, $18.3M undrawn), SocGen-led project finance (DFC due diligence COMPLETE per Q1-26 PR — a DD milestone, not a funding decision), and a StanChart-led strategic process at multiple-offers stage with asset-level change of control explicitly on the table (6/8/26 PR) and conclusion guided 'shortly'. No binding agreements as of early July 2026; company FID language has slid mid-2026 (12/11/25 PR) to late-2026 (FY-25 results 3/19/26), so 2026-12-31 is the operative outer bound with zero slack. Target is DUAL-MARKED: $7.04 is a deck-price cap (FS deck $8.49/lb Ni, verified) conditional on FID/partner terms struck on a long-term deck; spot Ni ~$7.43/lb (6-mo low, ~14% below deck) marks the same formula at ~$4.82 (band $4.47-5.20 via Lifezone's own FS NPV sensitivity). Two dated interim triggers precede the milestone: Indonesia RKAB supplementary-quota decision ~Jul-31 (potential +25-30% supply, bearish deck overhang) and any StanChart process announcement.
LZM.kill_risk: Mid-2026 FID target lapsed with zero binding agreements and company language now 'late-2026', leaving no slack inside the 12-31 window — slip-to-2027 is a live tail (BHP walked from this asset in 2025; the 'very advanced' StanChart process has run since Dec-2025 without closing). Deal-structure risk ON catalyst day: a 30-49% sell-down or 100% asset sale — both on the table per the 6/8/26 PR — restructures the 84%-attributable NAV the SoP target assumes at the moment it fires. Deck risk: spot Ni $16.3-16.4k/t ($7.40-7.45/lb) sits ~14% below the $8.49/lb FS deck at a 6-month low with the RKAB ~Jul-31 quota decision a dated bearish overhang; company FS sensitivity puts NPV at ~$1.10B at spot (-30% vs $1.58B), collapsing spot-marked R:R below the kill line. Balance sheet: Q1 cash $15.3M, ~$10M/qtr burn, $18.3M undrawn bridge, Taurus covenant waivers — bridge-dependent until close; residual resolution as a dilutive raise or below-NAV divestiture instead of an FID re-rate.

LZM.dossier_note: SYNTHESIS 2026-07-03 (post-audit rebuild; integrates blind re-underwrite + three adversarially CONFIRMED external findings). Catalyst verified live and unfired: Kabanga FID/financial close, no binding agreement as of early July; PENDING_SOFT, staging=true, WATCH-tier G2 fail stands (offers exist, no disclosed term sheets — term-sheet conversion IS the awaited event). FV arithmetic reproduces exactly: 84% x $1.58B NPV8 (verified verbatim: $8.49/lb deck, IRR 23.3%, AISC $3.36/lb, capex $942M) -> (0.5x1327-30)/89.9 = $7.04, shares confirmed vs $345M mcap. But the deck FAILS at spot: LME Ni ~$16.4k/t = $7.43/lb, ~14% below deck, 6-mo low, June -14% on Indonesia RKAB politics (~67% of mined supply quota-administered; supplementary-quota window closes Jul-31, up to +25-30% floated). Spot-marked FV $4.82 (4.47-5.20) via the company's own sensitivity — carried as the bear-case/risk mark, NOT replacement fair value: the catalyst prices on TERMS, and a strategic acquirer (multiple offers, CoC on table, DFC DD complete, Tanzanian investor-state structural issues resolved at presidential level, June-26) underwrites a long-term deck. $7.04 therefore held as a cap; all R:R and kill-line tests must be dual-quoted. Floor corrected to $2.30 per the board's own 0.18x basis; financing-failure probability looks LOWER than at underwriting, but weak nickel + the ~$340-500M equity cheque vs $345M mcap keeps the floor level right. Liquidity thin: Q1 cash $15.3M, ~$10M/qtr burn, waivers — bridge-dependent until close.
